description: API Ninjas inflation: latest monthly and yearly inflation rates by country. Returns a list of { country, type, period, monthly_rate_pct, yearly_rate_pct }. Optionally filter by country name and index type (CPI or HICP). Example: inflation({ country: "United States", type: "CPI" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own API Ninjas key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: inflation
title: Inflation
